# GitHub and CI

This index describes versioned repository configuration. A workflow or YAML
file does not by itself enable the corresponding GitHub setting.

| Entry | Purpose |
|---|---|
| [Workflows](workflows/README.md) | Python/curation tests, structure, pilot evidence, secret scanning, and GitHub configuration validation. |
| [Pull request template](PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md) | Cross-domain impact, testing, provenance, localization, and review requirements. |
| [Issue templates](ISSUE_TEMPLATE/README.md) | English issue forms; submissions in English or German are welcome. |
| [Dependabot](dependabot.yml) | Weekly package and GitHub Actions update proposals; no automatic merge. |
| [Release notes configuration](release.yml) | Suggested changelog categories; matching GitHub labels must exist. |
| [Label taxonomy](labels.yml) | Versioned release, area, kind and state labels used by issue templates and release notes. |
| [CODEOWNERS](CODEOWNERS) | Review responsibilities for the publication chain. |
| [Continuous maintenance](../docs/governance/CONTINUOUS_MAINTENANCE.md) | PR, documentation, localization, knowledge, and release contract. |
| [Community/public presence](../docs/community/README.md) | Observed Discussions, Wiki, Projects, and funding state; drafts and owner actions. |

Repository rules, required status checks, dependency security settings, secret
scopes, and human reviewer requirements are configured in GitHub. They must be
observed and verified there; no repository file claims they are already active.
The [reviewed learning-content flow](../knowledge/concepts/progressions/README.md)
describes the separate domain evidence required for knowledge publication.

## Project page

The root [README](../README.md) is the English project landing page;
[README.de.md](../README.de.md) is its German counterpart. They describe the
verified code state and link to the [implementation status](../docs/IMPLEMENTATION.md).
Update both when product status or user-visible behavior changes. The
illustration is generated by [`render_project_page_figure.py`](../scripts/render_project_page_figure.py).
Repository description, topics, Discussions categories, Wiki initialization,
Projects, and funding destinations are GitHub-side owner actions. Wiki and
Projects support are enabled, but the Wiki is not initialized and no linked
Projects v2 board was found in the 2026-11-18 assessment.

## Owner actions not completed by this PR

- Keep the GitHub labels in sync with [labels.yml](labels.yml); the
  2026-11-21 synchronization is tracked as OA-0041 in the
  [work register](../docs/operations/OFFENE_ARBEITSAUFFORDERUNGEN.md).
- Confirm/update branch rules, required checks, reviewers, and security
  settings. On 2026-11-21 `main` had no branch protection and the only active
  ruleset enabled Copilot code review (OA-0042).
- Review the observed Discussion categories and decide whether to add the
  optional category proposal in `docs/community/README.md`.
- Initialize the separate Wiki repository before any publication workflow is
  designed or enabled (the feature is enabled, but the Wiki returned 404).
- Create a GitHub Project and choose fields/views before automating issue sync
  (Projects is enabled, but no linked Projects v2 board was found).
- Add a funding configuration only after the owner has a verified supported
  sponsor destination. No placeholder account is provided.

## Deutsch

Dieses Verzeichnis enthält versionierte GitHub-Konfigurationen. Eine
Workflow- oder YAML-Datei aktiviert keine GitHub-Einstellung von selbst.

Die Root-[README](../README.md) ist die englische Projektseite;
[README.de.md](../README.de.md) ist die deutsche Fassung. Beide müssen bei
Änderungen an Produktstatus oder Nutzerverhalten mit dem
[Implementierungsstand](../docs/IMPLEMENTATION.md) abgeglichen werden.
Branch-Regeln, Statuschecks, Reviewer, Wiki, Discussions, Projects und Funding
bleiben GitHub-seitige Inhaberhandlungen.
